description: Additional schema info consumed by `mj codegen` (CodeGenLib additionalSchemaInfo). Declares IS-A (Table-Per-Type) inheritance relationships EXPLICITLY so CodeGen sets __mj.Entity.ParentID from config — it mirrors the parent's fields as virtual fields on the child and JOINs the parent in the child's base view, and (via LogSQLAndExecute) serializes the ParentID UPDATE into the CodeGen_Run migration so a clean deploy sets it too (#3004). This does NOT depend on CodeGen's schema-shape auto-detection (which can't reliably exclude non-IS-A tables that share the same single-PK-is-also-FK shape); the explicit declaration always wins.

ISARelationships._comment: EventProduct IS-A Product (Table-Per-Type): EventProduct's single PK (ID) is also an FK to Product.ID. ChildEntity + ParentEntity use BASE TABLE names + SchemaName so the binding is independent of the entity-name prefix; CodeGen matches by Name OR (BaseTable + SchemaName).
EventOrderLine IS-A OrderLine (same Table-Per-Type shape: EventOrderLine.ID PK is also an FK to OrderLine.ID).
